description: Source code for tensor pointwise operators in PyTorch's JIT Tensorexpr, including functions for computing sign, unary, binary, and multi-operand tensor operations.

methods.name: computeSign
methods.description: Computes the sign of a tensor element-wise.

methods.name: computeTwoOperandWithAlpha
methods.description: Computes a binary tensor operation with an alpha multiplier.

methods.name: computeConditionWithTwoOperand
methods.description: Computes a conditional tensor operation with two operands.

methods.name: computeNoop
methods.description: Performs a no-operation copy of tensor data.

methods.name: computeScalar
methods.description: Computes a scalar (single value) tensor operation.
